# secguard

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-secguard"
```

Package secguard is the root facade for the go\-secguard library. It re\-exports the sentinel errors and provides a Guard that wires the lockout, rate\-limit, ban\-tracking, and client\-IP components together.

# bantracker

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/bantracker"
```

Package bantracker detects credential\-stuffing clients by counting unique credential fingerprints per IP within a sliding window and banning abusive IPs. It also provides domain\-separated SHA\-256 fingerprint helpers and webhook signature extraction.

<a name="ExtractSignatureValue"></a>
## func [ExtractSignatureValue](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/bantracker/bantracker.go#L173>)

```go
func ExtractSignatureValue(getHeader func(string) string) string
```

ExtractSignatureValue extracts a webhook signature/token header using a framework\-agnostic header lookup function, checking X\-Hub\-Signature\-256, X\-Gitlab\-Token, X\-Hub\-Signature, and X\-Gitea\-Signature in priority order. It returns "unknown" when none are present.

<a name="BanTracker.RecordAndBan"></a>
### func \(\*BanTracker\) [RecordAndBan](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/bantracker/bantracker.go#L81>)

```go
func (bt *BanTracker) RecordAndBan(ip, fingerprint string, maxUniqueFailures int, banDuration, window time.Duration) bool
```

RecordAndBan records a credential failure for ip with the given SHA\-256 fingerprint and bans the IP for banDuration when the count of unique fingerprints within window reaches maxUniqueFailures. Executed under a single lock with throttled sweeps. Returns true if the IP is banned.

# domain

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/domain"
```

Package domain defines the sentinel errors and shared defaults used by every go\-secguard package. It depends only on the Go standard library.

## Index

- [Constants](<#constants>)
- [Variables](<#variables>)


## Constants

<a name="DefaultMaxEntries"></a>

```go
const (
    // DefaultMaxEntries bounds in-memory tracker maps (CWE-770).
    DefaultMaxEntries = 4096

    // DefaultMaxFailedAttempts is the number of consecutive failures before
    // lockout starts (CWE-307).
    DefaultMaxFailedAttempts = 5

    // DefaultBaseLockout is the initial lockout duration at threshold.
    DefaultBaseLockout = 30 * time.Second

    // DefaultMaxLockout caps exponential lockout growth.
    DefaultMaxLockout = 15 * time.Minute

    // DefaultEntryTTL is how long an idle lockout record is retained.
    DefaultEntryTTL = 30 * time.Minute

    // MaxLockoutShift caps exponential shift to prevent int64 duration overflow.
    MaxLockoutShift = 16

    // DefaultRateLimitMax is the default per-IP request limit per window.
    DefaultRateLimitMax = 60

    // DefaultRateLimitWindow is the default sliding window for RateLimiter.
    DefaultRateLimitWindow = time.Minute

    // DefaultLoginThrottleAttempts is the default per-account attempt limit per window.
    DefaultLoginThrottleAttempts = 10

    // DefaultLoginThrottleWindow is the default sliding window for LoginThrottle.
    DefaultLoginThrottleWindow = 5 * time.Minute

    // DefaultBanMaxUniqueFailures is the default unique credential failure
    // threshold before banning an IP.
    DefaultBanMaxUniqueFailures = 10

    // DefaultBanDuration is the default IP ban duration.
    DefaultBanDuration = 15 * time.Minute

    // DefaultBanWindow is the default sliding window for counting unique
    // credential failures.
    DefaultBanWindow = 5 * time.Minute
)
```

# headers

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/headers"
```

Package headers provides browser hardening response headers and Origin/Referer validation for mutating requests \(CWE\-352, CWE\-693, CWE\-1021, CWE\-319\).

## Index

- [func CheckMutationOrigin\(method, originHeader, refererHeader string, allowedOrigins \[\]string\) error](<#CheckMutationOrigin>)
- [func DefaultSecurityHeaders\(path string, isTLS bool\) map\[string\]string](<#DefaultSecurityHeaders>)

<a name="CheckMutationOrigin"></a>
## func [CheckMutationOrigin](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/headers/headers.go#L62>)

```go
func CheckMutationOrigin(method, originHeader, refererHeader string, allowedOrigins []string) error
```

CheckMutationOrigin validates Origin/Referer on mutating HTTP methods \(POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE\) against allowedOrigins \(CWE\-352\). Non\-mutating methods, requests without Origin/Referer \(non\-browser clients\), empty allowedOrigins, or an allowedOrigins entry of "\*" return nil. Otherwise returns domain.ErrOriginNotAllowed.

<a name="DefaultSecurityHeaders"></a>
## func [DefaultSecurityHeaders](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/headers/headers.go#L23>)

```go
func DefaultSecurityHeaders(path string, isTLS bool) map[string]string
```

DefaultSecurityHeaders returns the browser hardening response headers \(CWE\-693, CWE\-1021, CWE\-319\):

- X\-Frame\-Options: DENY
- X\-Content\-Type\-Options: nosniff
- Referrer\-Policy: no\-referrer
- Content\-Security\-Policy: frame\-ancestors 'none'
- Cache\-Control: no\-store \(when path is /api or has prefix /api/\)
- Strict\-Transport\-Security: max\-age=31536000; includeSubDomains \(when isTLS is true\)

## func [ExtractRequestOrigin](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/headers/headers.go#L42>)

```go
func ExtractRequestOrigin(originHeader, refererHeader string) string
```

ExtractRequestOrigin returns originHeader when non\-empty, or the "scheme://host" origin parsed from refererHeader when originHeader is empty. Returns "" if neither yields a valid origin.

<a name="LoginLimitKey"></a>
## func [LoginLimitKey](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/lockout/lockout.go#L72>)

```go
func LoginLimitKey(username, clientIP string) string
```

LoginLimitKey returns a collision\-resistant, case\-normalized lockout key for a login attempt: "login|\<sha256\(lower\(trim\(username\)\)\)\>|\<trim\(clientIP\)\>". Raw usernames are hashed to prevent CWE\-532 memory/log leakage.

<a name="PasswordChangeLimitKey"></a>
## func [PasswordChangeLimitKey](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/lockout/lockout.go#L79>)

```go
func PasswordChangeLimitKey(userID, clientIP string) string
```

PasswordChangeLimitKey returns a collision\-resistant lockout key for a password\-change attempt: "chpw|\<sha256\(trim\(userID\)\)\>|\<trim\(clientIP\)\>".

# realip

```go
import "github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/realip"
```

Package realip resolves the real client IP behind trusted reverse proxies using a right\-to\-left X\-Forwarded\-For walk \(CWE\-290, CWE\-348\).

## Index

- [func ExtractRealIP\(remoteAddr, xForwardedFor, xRealIP string, behindReverseProxy bool, trustedCIDRs \[\]\*net.IPNet\) \(net.IP, error\)](<#ExtractRealIP>)
- [func GetRealIPFromRequest\(r \*http.Request, behindReverseProxy bool, trustedCIDRs \[\]\*net.IPNet\) \(net.IP, error\)](<#GetRealIPFromRequest>)
- [func ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs\(entries \[\]string\) \(\[\]\*net.IPNet, error\)](<#ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs>)


<a name="ExtractRealIP"></a>
## func [ExtractRealIP](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/realip/realip.go#L51>)

```go
func ExtractRealIP(remoteAddr, xForwardedFor, xRealIP string, behindReverseProxy bool, trustedCIDRs []*net.IPNet) (net.IP, error)
```

ExtractRealIP resolves the client IP address. Forwarded headers \(X\-Forwarded\-For, X\-Real\-IP\) are honored ONLY when behindReverseProxy is true AND the direct peer \(remoteAddr\) belongs to trustedCIDRs. X\-Forwarded\-For is walked right\-to\-left, skipping trusted proxy hops, returning the first untrusted valid IP \(CWE\-348\).

<a name="GetRealIPFromRequest"></a>
## func [GetRealIPFromRequest](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/realip/realip.go#L83>)

```go
func GetRealIPFromRequest(r *http.Request, behindReverseProxy bool, trustedCIDRs []*net.IPNet) (net.IP, error)
```

GetRealIPFromRequest extracts the client IP from an \*http.Request using ExtractRealIP.

<a name="ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs"></a>
## func [ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs](<https://github.com/disaster37/go-secguard/blob/main/realip/realip.go#L18>)

```go
func ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs(entries []string) ([]*net.IPNet, error)
```

ParseTrustedProxyCIDRs parses a slice of CIDR strings or bare IP addresses into \[\]\*net.IPNet. Bare IPv4 addresses become /32 and bare IPv6 addresses become /128. Empty/whitespace\-only entries are skipped. Invalid entries return an error wrapping domain.ErrInvalidCIDR or domain.ErrInvalidIP.
